issues_found.details: cups-to-grams.html, egg-substitute.html, recipe-converter.html, baking-ratios.html, serving-size-calculator.html all exist locally but were not included in the Cloudflare Pages deployment. deploy_status.json shows only 6 files deployed. The sitemap references these URLs, so Googlebot is hitting 404s on 5/6 URLs in the sitemap.
issues_found.fix: Redeploy the full tools/ingredientcalculator/ directory via: wrangler pages deploy tools/ingredientcalculator --project-name=ingredientcalculator
issues_found.impact: 83% of content pages are invisible. Google is seeing soft 404s from the sitemap, which hurts crawl budget and trust signals.

issues_found.details: All sitemap URLs show lastmod 2026-05-07 (deployment date). The live sitemap.xml on Cloudflare only lists the homepage. The local sitemap references all 6 pages but the deployed version may differ.
issues_found.fix: After redeploying subpages, verify the live sitemap matches the local one with all 6 URLs.

issues_found.issue: No _redirects rules for subpage clean URLs
issues_found.details: _redirects only maps /calculator, /recipe-scaler, /unit-converter, /substitutions to index.html. No clean-URL redirects for the actual subpages (e.g., /cups-to-grams -> /cups-to-grams.html).
issues_found.fix: Add redirect rules for clean URLs: /cups-to-grams /cups-to-grams.html 200, etc. Cloudflare Pages may auto-serve .html files without extension, but verify after deploy.

financial_summary.notes: Cloudflare Pages free tier. Domain cost only. No monetization set up yet (no AdSense, no affiliate links).

assessment.competitive_landscape: highly competitive niche with established players (inchcalculator.com, mykitchencalculator.com, kitchenscaler.com, goodcalculators.com)
assessment.time_to_revenue: 6-12 months minimum if content is fixed and SEO work begins
assessment.notes: The domain has a strong exact-match keyword name (ingredientcalculator.com) which gives it inherent SEO value for long-tail queries. However, it was a fresh registration with zero prior authority, competing against well-established sites. The critical issue is that 83% of the content never made it to production.

recommendation.verdict: CONTINUE -- but FIX the deployment first

recommendation.reasoning: At $10.46 total cost with zero monthly overhead (Cloudflare Pages free tier), the downside is negligible. The domain name itself has intrinsic keyword value. The immediate ROI blocker is the broken deployment -- 83% of content is 404ing. Fix that first, then this becomes a valid long-term content play. Don't expect meaningful traffic for 3-6 months minimum.
